"""Verify the export_text single-feature fix in the local checkout.

Loads the local (patched) sklearn/tree/export.py on top of the venv's
compiled sklearn, plus the pre-fix version from git HEAD, and compares.
"""
import importlib.util
import subprocess
import sys

import sklearn  # venv's built sklearn provides compiled _tree etc.
import sklearn.tree as sktree

REPO = "C:/Users/agent/work/work/scikit-learn-14053-nopanel"


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


# pre-fix version straight from git HEAD
head_src = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "-C", REPO, "show", "HEAD:sklearn/tree/export.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
with open("C:/Windows/Temp/export_head.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(head_src)

old_mod = load("sklearn.tree.export_head", "C:/Windows/Temp/export_head.py")
new_mod = load("sklearn.tree.export_fixed", REPO + "/sklearn/tree/export.py")

from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, DecisionTreeRegressor

# --- 1. the exact reproduction from the issue -------------------------
X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)
X1 = X[:, 0].reshape(-1, 1)
tree = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=0)
tree.fit(X1, y)

print("=== PATCHED: issue reproduction (single feature) ===")
out = new_mod.export_text(tree, feature_names=["sepal_length"])
print(out)
assert "sepal_length" in out, "feature name missing from output"

# --- 2. same call on the pre-fix code: must raise IndexError ----------
print("=== PRE-FIX (git HEAD): same call ===")
try:
    old_mod.export_text(tree, feature_names=["sepal_length"])
    print("no error (unexpected)")
except IndexError as e:
    print("IndexError reproduced on pre-fix code:", e)

# --- 3. no behaviour change for multi-feature trees -------------------
tree4 = DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=0, max_depth=2).fit(X, y)
names = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
assert old_mod.export_text(tree4, feature_names=names) == \
       new_mod.export_text(tree4, feature_names=names), \
       "multi-feature output changed!"
assert old_mod.export_text(tree4) == new_mod.export_text(tree4), \
       "default-names output changed!"
print("=== multi-feature output identical before/after: OK ===")

# --- 4. generic names, single feature (feature_names=None) ------------
out2 = new_mod.export_text(tree)
assert "feature_0" in out2
print("=== single feature, default names: OK ===")

# --- 5. regressor + show_weights paths still fine ---------------------
reg = DecisionTreeRegressor(random_state=0, max_depth=2).fit(X1, y.astype(float))
r_old = old_mod.export_text(reg, feature_names=["f0"], show_weights=True)
r_new = new_mod.export_text(reg, feature_names=["f0"], show_weights=True)
assert r_old == r_new
print("=== regressor single-feature output identical: OK ===")

print("\nALL CHECKS PASSED")
